content:
The script failed to populate formulas in the 'Task' sheet because it relied on unverified assumptions about the 'Data' sheet layout.
Test failures in 'test_lookup_blocks' and 'test_derived_values_and_stats' reported 'None' in cells like H12 and H35 where expected values were 612.5 and 10.0. The logic for identifying series code lookup ranges (rows 21-38) and header data failed to correctly parameterize the INDEX/MATCH formulas. Consequently, the workbook save/load cycle resulted in empty cells instead of the required calculated values.
